about: Young animals and seasonal looks (3.3 batch, lane C), built by scripts/ark-young-life.mts from the species catalogue (AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json): only what a species' own stored text says. coats: the young of these species wear another coat (the look shader's young coat, young-coat.ts); colours are sRGB. mouthCarry: the parent that carries its hatchlings in its jaws to the water, or holds its fry in its mouth (mouth-carry.ts), after a hatching of the record; say = when the row's sentence is true of what is drawn. antlers: the antler cycle by the Ark year's months (antler-cycle.ts); cut = where the model's antlers start (y, zMin, zBase).

wild-boar.name: Wild Boar
wild-boar.quote: Their cream-and-brown stripes fade at around 3 to 4 months
wild-boar.line: {aAnimal} has piglets still wearing cream-and-brown stripes

south-american-tapir.name: South American Tapir
south-american-tapir.quote: Its reddish-brown coat is marked with pale stripes and spots that fade over its first several months
south-american-tapir.line: {aAnimal} has a reddish-brown calf marked with pale stripes and spots

bairds-tapir.name: Baird's Tapir
bairds-tapir.quote: Females usually bear a single striped calf that hides early, then follows the mother through forest and water routes.
bairds-tapir.line: {aAnimal} has a striped calf following her through forest and water

collared-peccary.name: Collared Peccary
collared-peccary.quote: wear a reddish-brown coat with a dark stripe down the back until they grow the adult coat
collared-peccary.line: {aAnimal} has a young one in a reddish-brown coat with a dark back stripe

african-lion.name: African Lion
african-lion.quote: Plain tawny coat; cubs are born faintly spotted
african-lion.line: {aAnimal} cub is showing the faint spots it was born with

francois-langur.name: Francois' Langur
francois-langur.quote: Infants are born bright orange, contrasting sharply with the darker adults.
francois-langur.line: {aAnimal} infant is showing bright orange among the darker adults

blue-wildebeest.name: Blue Wildebeest
blue-wildebeest.quote: Calves are born a pale tawny brown and take on the darker adult colouring within their first few months.
blue-wildebeest.line: {aAnimal} has a pale tawny calf that has not yet darkened

black-spiny-tailed-iguana.name: Black Spiny-tailed Iguana
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.quote: Hatchlings are bright green and hunt insects, but as they grow they turn grey-brown
black-spiny-tailed-iguana.line: {aAnimal} is a bright green hatchling hunting insects

emerald-tree-boa.name: Emerald Tree Boa
emerald-tree-boa.quote: Newborns are usually brick-red or orange, not green, and change colour gradually over about their first year.
emerald-tree-boa.line: {aAnimal} is a brick-red newborn, not yet green

leopard-gecko.name: Leopard Gecko
leopard-gecko.quote: Juveniles are banded dark and pale, not spotted.
leopard-gecko.line: {aAnimal} is a youngster banded dark and pale, not yet spotted

red-tegu.name: Red Tegu
red-tegu.quote: Juveniles brown with pale bands, reddening as they grow
red-tegu.line: {aAnimal} is a brown youngster with pale bands, not yet red

saltwater-crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile
saltwater-crocodile.quote: Juveniles pale yellowish with dark bands and spots
saltwater-crocodile.line: {aAnimal} is a pale yellowish youngster with dark bands and spots

spectacled-caiman.name: Spectacled Caiman
spectacled-caiman.quote: Juveniles yellowish with bold black bands
spectacled-caiman.line: {aAnimal} is a yellowish youngster with bold black bands

eastern-rat-snake.name: Eastern Rat Snake
eastern-rat-snake.quote: Juveniles are grey with dark blotches along the back
eastern-rat-snake.line: {aAnimal} is a grey youngster with dark blotches along its back

southeastern-five-lined-skink.name: Southeastern Five-lined Skink
southeastern-five-lined-skink.quote: Juveniles have a vivid blue tail
southeastern-five-lined-skink.line: {aAnimal} is a youngster showing off its vivid blue tail

gray-angelfish.name: Gray Angelfish
gray-angelfish.quote: Juveniles black with yellow vertical bands
gray-angelfish.line: {aAnimal} juvenile is black with yellow vertical bands

blue-tang.name: Blue Tang
blue-tang.quote: Juveniles shelter in branching cauliflower coral and only later move to open reef.
blue-tang.line: {aAnimal} juvenile is sheltering in branching cauliflower coral

goldfish.name: Goldfish
goldfish.quote: Young goldfish are dark olive-bronze and turn gold over their first year
goldfish.line: {aAnimal} youngster is still dark olive-bronze, not yet gold

boesemans-rainbowfish.name: Boeseman's Rainbowfish
boesemans-rainbowfish.quote: Juveniles are plain silvery grey, and males take about a year to develop full adult colour.
boesemans-rainbowfish.line: {aAnimal} juvenile is still plain silvery grey, its adult colour yet to come

zebra-shark.name: Zebra Shark
zebra-shark.quote: Young are dark brown with narrow yellowish stripes, while adults are pale with many small dark spots.
zebra-shark.line: {aAnimal} youngster is dark brown with narrow yellowish stripes

brownbanded-bamboo-shark.name: Brownbanded Bamboo Shark
brownbanded-bamboo-shark.quote: Juveniles boldly banded; adults often plain brown
brownbanded-bamboo-shark.line: {aAnimal} juvenile is showing the bold bands of its youth

greater-amberjack.name: Greater Amberjack
greater-amberjack.quote: Juveniles under drifting weed have bold dark vertical bars, which fade as they grow.
greater-amberjack.line: {aAnimal} juvenile is sheltering under drifting weed, bold dark bars on its sides

spotted-barb.name: Spotted Barb
spotted-barb.quote: Young fish show extra dark bars or blotches along the flank
spotted-barb.line: {aAnimal} youngster is showing extra dark bars along its flank

iridescent-shark.name: Iridescent Shark
iridescent-shark.quote: Young fish glossy, with two dark stripes along each side
iridescent-shark.line: {aAnimal} youngster is glossy, with two dark stripes along each side

bluestreak-cleaner-wrasse.name: Bluestreak Cleaner Wrasse
bluestreak-cleaner-wrasse.quote: Juveniles are black with a vivid blue line along the back
bluestreak-cleaner-wrasse.line: {aAnimal} juvenile is black with a vivid blue line along its back

blueface-angelfish.name: Blueface Angelfish
blueface-angelfish.quote: Juveniles look quite different from adults, dark blue with pale curved bars.
blueface-angelfish.line: {aAnimal} juvenile is dark blue with pale curved bars

little-blue-heron.name: Little Blue Heron
little-blue-heron.quote: The Little Blue Heron is pure white for its first year, which lets the young bird wade among snowy egrets before it slowly turns slate blue.
little-blue-heron.line: {aAnimal} youngster is wading, pure white, among snowy egrets

sun-conure.name: Sun Conure
sun-conure.quote: Young birds are largely green and gain this yellow as they mature.
sun-conure.line: {aAnimal} youngster is still largely green, its yellow yet to come

scarlet-ibis.name: Scarlet Ibis
scarlet-ibis.quote: Young birds are duller and develop color as they mature and consume these foods.
scarlet-ibis.line: {aAnimal} youngster is still dull, its colour yet to come

ring-billed-gull.name: Ring-billed Gull
ring-billed-gull.quote: Young birds take three years to reach adult plumage, passing through mottled brown and grey stages on the way.
ring-billed-gull.line: {aAnimal} youngster is still wearing its mottled brown and grey feathers

yellow-legged-gull.name: Yellow-legged Gull
yellow-legged-gull.quote: Young birds are mottled brown and take four years to gain the grey and white adult plumage.
yellow-legged-gull.line: {aAnimal} youngster is showing its mottled brown feathers

southern-black-widow.name: Southern Black Widow
southern-black-widow.quote: Young spiders are pale with white, yellow and orange markings and darken as they mature.
southern-black-widow.line: {aAnimal} is young and pale, with white, yellow and orange markings

leopard-slug.name: Leopard Slug
leopard-slug.quote: Young slugs tend to be paler and less boldly marked, with the full pattern developing as they grow.
leopard-slug.line: {aAnimal} is young, still pale and less boldly marked

variegated-meadowhawk.name: Variegated Meadowhawk
variegated-meadowhawk.quote: Colour changes with age: young adults are yellow-brown and mature males redden
variegated-meadowhawk.line: {aAnimal} is showing its age in colour, yellow-brown when young and reddening later

ant-mimic-mantis.name: Ant Mimic Mantis
ant-mimic-mantis.quote: The Ant Mimic Mantis hatches as a shiny black nymph that looks and scurries like an ant, then turns leaf green as it grows up.
ant-mimic-mantis.line: {aAnimal} nymph is scurrying about shiny and black, looking like an ant

giant-malaysian-leaf-insect.name: Giant Malaysian Leaf Insect
giant-malaysian-leaf-insect.quote: Newly hatched nymphs are reddish-brown and active, and turn green once they start eating leaves.
giant-malaysian-leaf-insect.line: {aAnimal} nymph is newly hatched, reddish-brown and active, not yet green

mantled-guereza.name: Mantled Guereza
mantled-guereza.quote: Infants are born mostly white before developing adult coloration.
mantled-guereza.line: {aAnimal} infant is showing the white coat it was born with

american-alligator.name: American Alligator
american-alligator.quote: sometimes carrying young gently in the mouth
american-alligator.line: {aAnimal} is carrying her young gently in her mouth

mugger-crocodile.name: Mugger Crocodile
mugger-crocodile.quote: She guards the nest, opens it when the young call, and carries hatchlings to water in her mouth.
mugger-crocodile.line: {aAnimal} is opening her nest at the hatchlings' calls and carrying them to water

saltwater-crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile
saltwater-crocodile.quote: Hatchlings call from inside the egg, and the female opens the nest and carries them to water in her mouth.
saltwater-crocodile.line: {aAnimal} is opening her nest and carrying the hatchlings to water in her mouth

asian-arowana.name: Asian Arowana
asian-arowana.quote: After spawning he takes the few, large, yolky eggs into his mouth and carries eggs and then young for roughly two months
asian-arowana.line: {aAnimal} is carrying his large eggs in his mouth

silver-arowana.name: Silver Arowana
silver-arowana.quote: the male takes them into his mouth, carrying the eggs and then the young for around six to eight weeks
silver-arowana.line: {aAnimal} is carrying his eggs and young in his mouth

nile-tilapia.name: Nile Tilapia
nile-tilapia.quote: Females carry the fertilised eggs and newly hatched fry in their mouths, and the young dart back inside when danger threatens.
nile-tilapia.line: {aAnimal} is letting her fry dart back inside her mouth at danger

eurasian-elk.name: Eurasian Elk
eurasian-elk.quote: grow antlers each summer, shed in early winter
eurasian-elk.why: bulls: summer growth, shed in early winter

reindeer.name: Reindeer
reindeer.quote: Both males and females often grow antlers, and females usually keep theirs through winter after males have shed.
reindeer.line: {aAnimal} is still wearing her antlers after the males have shed theirs
reindeer.why: both sexes; males bare in winter

red-deer.name: Red Deer
red-deer.quote: Growing antlers are among the fastest-growing tissues of any mammal, covered in velvet skin until they harden.
red-deer.line: {aAnimal} is growing new antlers covered in velvet skin
red-deer.why: velvet the three months before the stored rut

chital.name: Chital
chital.quote: Stags shed and regrow their antlers every year but not in step with one another, so some stags in hard antler can be seen in any month.
chital.line: {aAnimal} is carrying hard antlers, out of step with the other stags
chital.why: stags, each on his own year
